# this is the build file for project 2025_c_practice_1
# it is autogenerated by the xmake build system.
# do not edit by hand.

# project
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15.0)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0091 NEW)
project(2025_c_practice_1 LANGUAGES C)
set(CURRENT_COMPILER_ID ${CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID})

# target
add_executable(question1 "")
set_target_properties(question1 PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME "question1")
set_target_properties(question1 PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/build/windows/x64/debug")
target_compile_options(question1 PRIVATE
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C>:/source-charset:utf-8>
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:-G>
)
set_target_properties(question1 PROPERTIES C_EXTENSIONS OFF)
target_compile_features(question1 PRIVATE c_std_99)
if(CURRENT_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "MSVC")
    target_compile_options(question1 PRIVATE $<$<CONFIG:Debug>:-Od>)
else()
    target_compile_options(question1 PRIVATE -O0)
endif()
if(CURRENT_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "MSVC")
    target_compile_options(question1 PRIVATE -Zi)
else()
    target_compile_options(question1 PRIVATE -g)
endif()
if(CURRENT_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "MSVC")
    set_property(TARGET question1 PROPERTY
        MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreadedDebugDLL")
endif()
# private sourcefiles from sourcebatch c.build for target question1
target_sources(question1 PRIVATE 
    src/question1.c
)
